digest.component_or_area: mutation gate / bounded mutation gate workflow
propositions: Mutation gate script hard-fails (exit code 2) when checking out a patchset based on a commit older than the commit that introduced scripts/mutation_gate.py, because the script is absent from the checked-out tree

Sibling gates (env-var registry gate, check_comment_hygiene.py) already implement guards that skip gracefully with explanatory messages when their scripts are missing; mutation gate is the only one lacking this guard

A change based before the walking-skeleton commit receives Verified -1 from the mutation gate due to the hard-fail, incorrectly reporting gate failure rather than indicating the change predates the gate

Mutation gate must skip cleanly (exit 0 with explanatory message) when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching sibling gate behavior, while still running the gate for changes based at or after the script's introduction commit
